# primitives.library: Repeat

**Status:** Supported (tier `foundation`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> n copies of x. The count comes first because the compiler requires a
> concrete first parameter, so the V1 form Repeat(x, n) became Repeat(n, x).
